strNotes: Adds a CREDIT app to the PDA home screen. It lists what you owe from your own ledger: Ogiso's Bank's starting mortgage, ship mortgages, fines, bills waiting to be paid and regular charges, with each loan's balance and next instalment, and a button into the Finances window where bills are paid. It reads the ledger only; it lends nothing yet. Requires Phobos Framework 0.126.0 or newer and the normal game/BepInEx prerequisites. Not gameplay-validated.
